_comment_readme: Copy this file to config.json (cp config.example.json config.json) and fill in the values below. The keys starting with an underscore are comments — the bot ignores them, so you can leave them in or delete them. IDs must be numbers (no quotes); the token must be a string (in quotes).
_comment_token: Your Discord bot token from the Developer Portal (Bot > Reset Token). Keep this secret — never commit config.json.
_comment_owner: Your own Discord user ID. Only this user can run the `restart` command. Enable Developer Mode in Discord, then right-click your name > Copy User ID.
_comment_poketwo_bot_id: The Poketwo bot's user ID (the game bot whose spawns are tracked). The value below is Poketwo's public ID and usually does not need changing.
_comment_trackers: User IDs of the tracker bots the bot listens to for hunt pings. Set these to the PokeName, Poketox and P2 Assistant bot IDs in your server.
_comment_lock_delay: Seconds to wait before locking a channel after a hunt is detected. 0 = lock immediately. This is a global default and can be overridden per server with /set_lock_delay.
_comment_durations: How long (in seconds) to keep a channel locked for each hunt type. 3600 = 1 hour. These are global defaults; override them per server with the matching /set_ slash commands.
_comment_server_configs: Per-server overrides. Leave this as an empty object — the bot fills it in automatically when you use the /set_ commands.
_comment_locked_channels: Runtime state for channels the bot has locked. Leave this as an empty object — the bot manages it itself.
